text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having business with Azuma-san, 
I paid another visit to the Shuntaisai 
operations headquarters.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I have duly received your request for this 
matter. 
Now then—

text_block_list.name: Human Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text:
Like I said...! We should reorganize the 
operations divisions 
separately into humans and Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Human Shrine Maiden B
text_block_list.text:
Our physical capabilities and specialized 
tasks are completely different, 
so we ought to split the divisions and 
work in a way 
that plays to our respective strengths.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text:
The festival we're taking part in honors 
the bond between humans and Umamusume, 
doesn't it? 
We should stick to tradition and help each 
other out in mixed teams...!
choice_data_list:
(Sounds like they're really divided on 
this.)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Division assignments, is it...? 
It appears both sides hold convictions 
they cannot yield.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden B
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things get tough for the humans, 
we Umamusume will cover for you, so it'll 
be fine. 
Can't we just keep doing things the way we 
always have?

text_block_list.name: Human Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because that keeps turning 
into a burden 
on the Umamusume side that we're 
suggesting 
we separate the divisions in the first 
place...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Were I to side with either, the dispute 
would settle... 
Yet that is not a virtuous path.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This friction is also a conflict necessary 
for their growth. 
If they exchange words, their hearts shall 
eventually align. 
—Now then.

text_block_list.name: Human Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Lady Azuma! This is—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I shall accept whatever decision you all 
arrive at. 
However, reflect upon this once more.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For whose sake are your own words spoken, 
and for whose sake are the words of the 
one before you?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maidens
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text:
From a human perspective... you notice 
details 
that Umamusume tend to overlook, right? 
That's why you're always such a huge help 
to us.

text_block_list.name: Human Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text:
...We knew that the Umamusume appreciated 
us. 
It's just that there were times when we 
felt we were holding you back, and that 
was the truth.

text_block_list.name: Human Shrine Maiden A
text_block_list.text:
I thought splitting the divisions would be 
better, but... 
I suppose that wouldn't really benefit 
either of us, would it?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
All's well that ends well, 
as they say.
choice_data_list:
How did you know that would resolve 
things?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It is merely something I learned 
through experience and my own past 
failures...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Across the flowing days, there were 
times 
when discord arose between humans and 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Long ago, I was still naive... 
Believing I could prevent sorrow, I 
intervened 
and chose to part their paths.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yet that was no different from robbing 
them of a future together. 
In truth, it brought only deeper suffering 
to both.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Only after repeating mistake upon mistake 
did I finally awaken... to my own 
arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The children of humankind, and the 
children of umamusume... 
Both possess the power to choose their own 
noble path and forge true bonds.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To simply have faith and watch over that 
journey— 
that is the true and righteous path for 
me.
choice_data_list:
(She has such a profound, enlightened 
perspective...)
That sounds like a wonderful path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling it "wonderful" hardly does justice 
to how transcendent her view is. 
Could I ever reach such heights with 
enough experience?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
That merely means you have room to grow. 
There is no need to fret.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As you witness many journeys unfolding 
before you, 
you will surely arrive at a path uniquely 
your own.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. 
Though it did require quite a bit of 
discipline.
choice_data_list:
I hope I can reach the right path someday 
too.

I hope I can reach the right path someday 
too.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
If it is you, I have no doubt. 
I shall quietly watch over your valiant 
efforts.

title: Believing and Watching Over Your Steps
